statement.document_title: The CNET Fake News Fiasco, Autopilot, and the Uncanny Cognitive Valley

from_speaker: about to head into an era
our_interpretation: The ordinary reading is that AI will become commonplace across everyday and professional activities while continuing to make errors.
Ubiquitous does not require every person to use AI, but availability or adoption of one product alone cannot establish it.
About to implies a near-term transition but supplies no calendar deadline. No numerical adoption threshold is added.
criteria.support_condition: Broad evidence establishes commonplace AI use across everyday and professional settings, alongside documented errors, in the transition following January 2023.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Evidence establishes a settled contrary outcome within the intended transition. Nonoccurrence by an evaluator-selected deadline cannot contradict this undated forecast.
